title: Refund policy
text: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refundable, but you can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the billing period. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days.

title: Plans and pricing
text: Nimbus has three plans. Starter is free for up to 3 projects. Team costs $12 per seat per month and adds unlimited projects and audit logs. Enterprise is priced per contract and adds SSO, a 99.95% uptime SLA and a dedicated support engineer.

title: Invoices and receipts
text: Workspace owners can download invoices as PDF from Settings > Billing > Invoices. Invoices are issued on the first day of each billing period. To add a VAT or GST number, edit the billing profile before the next invoice is issued; past invoices cannot be changed.

title: Adding and removing seats
text: Seats are billed pro rata. Adding a seat mid-cycle charges the remaining fraction of the month immediately. Removing a seat issues a credit that is applied to the next invoice, not a refund.

title: Single sign-on
text: SSO is available on the Enterprise plan and supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect. Okta, Azure AD and Google Workspace have guided setup. Once SSO is enforced, password logins are disabled for all members except workspace owners, who keep a password as a break-glass account.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Members can enable two-factor authentication with an authenticator app or a hardware security key. Workspace owners on Team and Enterprise can require 2FA for everyone. SMS codes are not supported.

title: Session length
text: Web sessions expire after 14 days of inactivity. Enterprise admins can shorten this to as little as 1 hour. API tokens do not expire unless an expiry date is set when the token is created.

title: API rate limits
text: The REST API allows 100 requests per minute per token on Starter and 1,000 requests per minute on Team and Enterprise. Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Bulk endpoints count as one request per call regardless of batch size.

title: Webhooks
text: Webhooks deliver JSON events over HTTPS and are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature in the X-Nimbus-Signature header. Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours, after which the event is dropped and shown in the delivery log.

title: Pagination
text: List endpoints use cursor pagination. Pass the next_cursor value from a response as the cursor parameter to get the next page. Page size defaults to 50 and can be raised to 200 with the limit parameter.

title: Data retention
text: Deleted projects stay in the trash for 30 days and can be restored by any admin during that time. After 30 days they are permanently deleted. Audit logs are kept for 1 year on Team and 7 years on Enterprise.

title: Exporting data
text: Admins can export a full workspace as a ZIP of JSON files from Settings > Data > Export. Exports run in the background and a download link is emailed when ready; the link is valid for 7 days. Attachments larger than 2 GB are exported as links rather than files.

title: Data residency
text: Workspaces are hosted in the US by default. Enterprise customers can choose EU (Frankfurt) or India (Mumbai) hosting when the workspace is created. Moving an existing workspace between regions requires a support-assisted migration.

title: Backups
text: All workspace data is backed up every 6 hours and backups are retained for 35 days. Backups are encrypted with AES-256 and stored in a separate region from the primary data.

title: Project limits
text: Each project can hold up to 10,000 tasks and 50 GB of attachments. Individual file uploads are limited to 5 GB. Archived projects do not count toward the Starter plan's 3-project limit.

title: Guest access
text: Guests can be invited to individual projects and do not use a paid seat. Guests can comment and edit tasks in projects they are invited to but cannot create projects or see the member directory. Starter workspaces can have up to 5 guests.

title: Slack integration
text: The Slack app posts task updates to a channel and lets members create tasks with the /nimbus command. Each project can be linked to one Slack channel. The integration requires a Slack workspace admin to approve the app.

title: GitHub integration
text: Linking a GitHub repository lets Nimbus close tasks automatically when a pull request that mentions the task key is merged. Both GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Server 3.8 or later are supported.

title: Support hours
text: Support is available by email around the clock for all plans. Team customers get a first response within 1 business day. Enterprise customers get a first response within 1 hour for urgent issues, 24/7, plus a dedicated support engineer.

title: Uptime and status
text: Live service status and incident history are published at status.nimbus.example. The Enterprise SLA guarantees 99.95% monthly uptime; if it is missed, customers receive service credits of 10% of the monthly fee for each 0.1% below the target, capped at 50%.
